<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>THE TOWN THAT REBUILDS ITSELF — Next Generation</title>
<style>
:root{--accent:#8fe6c6;--bg:#08131b;--panel:#12222c;--line:rgba(191,239,246,.16);--text:#ebf6f8;--muted:#9cb4bc;--paper:#f1e7d7;--ink:#27323a}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:radial-gradient(circle at top,#102331,#08131b 42%,#05090d 100%);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}h1,h2,h3,h4,p{margin:.35em 0}.eyebrow,small{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}.eyebrow{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--accent);font-weight:800}.muted{color:var(--muted)}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(5,12,17,.86);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}.brand h1{font-size:1.12rem;margin:0}.brand p{font-size:.8rem;color:#cedddd}.toptools{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.btn{background:#173241;color:#effbff;border:1px solid rgba(210,247,251,.18);border-radius:11px;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:700}.btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:#204457}.btn.gold{background:var(--accent);color:#041118;border-color:var(--accent)}.btn.ghost{background:rgba(12,23,29,.7)}.btn.slim{padding:7px 10px;font-size:.79rem}.btn.danger{border-color:#8e5151;color:#ffd4d1}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;padding:11px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.stat{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(19,35,45,.96),rgba(9,16,22,.96));padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px}.stat label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700}.bar{height:7px;border-radius:999px;background:#203544;margin-top:7px;overflow:hidden}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),#e1fff7);border-radius:999px}
.main{max-width:1880px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(620px,1.35fr) minmax(350px,.8fr);gap:14px}.panel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,34,44,.96),rgba(9,17,23,.96));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}.viewport{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:620px}.leftcol,.rightcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:0}.rightcol .panel{padding:14px}
.viewportTop{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;top:16px;z-index:5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}.titleCard,.infoCard{background:rgba(5,16,22,.78);border:1px solid rgba(235,250,255,.14);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 14px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}.titleCard{max-width:58%}.titleCard p,.infoCard p{font-size:.84rem;color:#dbe7eb}.infoCard{max-width:34ch}.sceneBg{position:absolute;inset:-4%;background-size:cover;background-position:center;transform:scale(1.06);animation:pan 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,11,16,.74),transparent 20%,transparent 72%,rgba(3,10,15,.84) 100%),radial-gradient(circle at center,transparent 35%,rgba(0,0,0,.45) 100%);pointer-events:none}.fog,.scan,.water,.drift,.flicker{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}.fog{background:radial-gradient(circle at 22% 76%,rgba(245,255,255,.12),transparent 0 18%),radial-gradient(circle at 78% 28%,rgba(245,255,255,.08),transparent 0 12%);filter:blur(18px);animation:fog 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.scan{opacity:.22;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 0 2px,transparent 2px 6px)}.water{background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 60%,rgba(160,226,255,.08) 70%,rgba(160,226,255,.02) 100%);mask:repeating-linear-gradient(92deg,rgba(0,0,0,.94) 0 18px,rgba(0,0,0,.52) 18px 20px);animation:water 4.5s linear infinite alternate;opacity:.44}.drift{background:radial-gradient(circle at 10% 20%,rgba(130,220,255,.10) 0 1px,transparent 2px),radial-gradient(circle at 40% 70%,rgba(130,220,255,.12) 0 1px,transparent 2px),radial-gradient(circle at 83% 45%,rgba(130,220,255,.09) 0 1px,transparent 2px);background-size:280px 280px;animation:stars 22s linear infinite;opacity:.35}.flicker{background:radial-gradient(circle at 76% 18%,rgba(255,245,195,.20),transparent 0 15%);animation:flick 3s infinite steps(1,end)}
@keyframes pan{from{transform:scale(1.06) translate(0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.11) translate(-1.5%,1.2%)}}@keyframes fog{from{transform:translateX(-2%)}to{transform:translateX(2%)}}@keyframes water{from{transform:translateX(-1%)}to{transform:translateX(1%)}}@keyframes stars{to{background-position:70px 110px,-60px 80px,30px -90px}}@keyframes flick{0%,18%,22%,60%,100%{opacity:.16}20%,21%,57%{opacity:.04}}
.mapBack{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,rgba(52,125,142,.22),transparent 0 18%),radial-gradient(circle at 70% 68%,rgba(102,173,170,.16),transparent 0 20%),linear-gradient(135deg,#14212e,#081017 55%,#0a1821)}.mapBack:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-10%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 0 38px,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 39px,transparent 40px);animation:grid 28s linear infinite}@keyframes grid{to{transform:translate(-50px,22px)}}.mapWrap{position:absolute;inset:118px 16px 16px 16px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid rgba(208,244,247,.12);overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(21,36,48,.82),rgba(8,15,22,.92))}.mapOverlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 22% 74%,rgba(51,136,156,.18),transparent 0 22%),radial-gradient(circle at 76% 18%,rgba(78,172,164,.10),transparent 0 18%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.02),transparent 30%)}.mapLines{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.node{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:5;border:none;background:none;padding:0;text-align:center;color:#eff8fa}.node>div{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(7,20,28,.92);border:2px solid rgba(184,243,243,.35);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(8,18,25,.35),0 0 24px rgba(111,245,234,.08);font-weight:900;transition:.18s}.node span{display:block;margin-top:7px;width:130px;margin-left:-39px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:#d9ecee;text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}.node.unlocked>div{border-color:rgba(193,255,255,.74)}.node.current>div{border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(17,54,60,.95)}.node.locked{opacity:.35;filter:grayscale(1)}.node:hover:not(.locked)>div{transform:scale(1.06)}.chapterBadge{position:absolute;top:-11px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:3px 6px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(5,18,23,.88);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.12em;border:1px solid rgba(212,243,249,.14)}.avatar{position:absolute;z-index:7;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 180deg,var(--accent),#e6fff6 40%,var(--accent));box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(188,255,248,.3),0 0 0 4px rgba(6,16,22,.6);transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}.avatar:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#08202a}.arrival{position:absolute;z-index:8;transform:translate(-50%,0);background:rgba(7,19,25,.92);border:1px solid rgba(221,247,252,.25);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;min-width:190px}.arrival h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:.85rem}.mapFooter,.sceneBottom{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-end;z-index:6}.chip{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid rgba(211,241,247,.16);border-radius:999px;background:#122b39;font-size:.75rem;color:#dceff3;font-weight:700;margin:4px 4px 0 0}.chip.active{background:var(--accent);color:#041018;border-color:var(--accent)}
.hotspot{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:6;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(5,18,26,.9);border:1px solid rgba(206,247,255,.48);color:white;border-radius:14px;padding:8px 10px;max-width:220px;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(8,19,26,.36),0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;text-align:left}.hotspot .orb{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--accent);color:#061219;flex:none;font-weight:900}.hotspot:hover{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.05)}.hotspot.seen{opacity:.75}.pulseRing{position:absolute;inset:-10px;border:1px solid rgba(198,255,247,.45);border-radius:999px;animation:pulse 1.8s infinite;pointer-events:none}@keyframes pulse{0%{transform:scale(.72);opacity:.55}100%{transform:scale(1.18);opacity:0}}
.rightcol .tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}.tab{background:#122837;color:#dbeef2;border:1px solid rgba(203,239,244,.15);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800}.tab.active{background:var(--accent);color:#051017;border-color:var(--accent)}.pane{margin-top:10px;min-height:420px}.callout{padding:11px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(14,30,40,.85);border:1px solid rgba(211,243,248,.12);margin-bottom:10px}.list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.entry{background:rgba(6,17,24,.65);border:1px solid rgba(211,243,248,.12);border-radius:12px;padding:11px}.entry h4{font-size:.92rem}.entry p{font-size:.83rem}.meta{font-size:.7rem;color:#a2b7bf;letter-spacing:.08em}.soft{color:#d7e7ea;font-size:.84rem}.quizrow{padding:10px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(10,22,30,.8);border:1px solid rgba(211,243,248,.12);margin:8px 0}select,.textin,textarea{width:100%;background:#0d1d29;border:1px solid rgba(203,239,244,.18);color:#eefbff;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px}textarea{min-height:210px;line-height:1.55;resize:vertical}.frames{padding:10px;border:1px dashed rgba(213,243,248,.18);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.6}.picked{padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:#14313a;border:1px solid rgba(203,239,244,.18);margin:6px 0}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;place-items:center;background:rgba(3,10,14,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);z-index:90;padding:18px}.modal.open{display:grid}.dialog{width:min(950px,94vw);max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(224,250,255,.14);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#132431,#0a141c)}.dialogHead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(224,250,255,.12)}.dialogBody{padding:18px}.paper{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f6efe4,#e4d7bf);color:var(--ink);border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #d4c0a1;padding:18px 20px}.paper .meta{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.74rem;color:#5d6972;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);padding-top:8px;margin-top:8px}.paper ul{padding-left:20px}.clipFrame{position:relative;height:320px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(216,245,255,.16);background:#09141b}.clipBg{position:absolute;inset:-10%;background-size:cover;background-position:center;animation:clipPan 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.clipOverlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,10,15,.22),rgba(2,10,15,.55)),repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 0 2px,transparent 2px 5px)}.focusDot{position:absolute;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.15);animation:focusPulse 2s infinite}@keyframes clipPan{from{transform:scale(1.05) translate(0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.13) translate(-3%,1%)}}@keyframes focusPulse{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.75);opacity:.6}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.3);opacity:0}}.dialogueOption{width:100%;text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;margin-top:8px;border-radius:14px;background:#123041;border:1px solid rgba(204,242,248,.18);color:#eefbff}.toast{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:99;background:rgba(5,18,23,.92);border:1px solid rgba(215,244,248,.18);padding:12px 15px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.28);max-width:420px;display:none}.toast.show{display:block}
@media (max-width:1100px){.main{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}.viewport{min-height:540px}.titleCard{max-width:100%}.infoCard{display:none}}

/* 2026 visual evidence production pass: diegetic exhibit design */
.dialog{width:min(1260px,96vw);max-height:92vh;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(171,251,232,.38);background:#091922;box-shadow:0 35px 110px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.dialogHead{padding:12px 20px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,55,64,.98),rgba(9,26,34,.98));border-bottom:1px solid rgba(170,242,228,.25)}
.dialogHead h3{font-size:1rem;margin:3px 0}.dialogBody{padding:0}
.evidenceUniverse{position:relative;padding:16px 20px 18px;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.evidenceUniverse::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,17,23,.98),rgba(5,17,23,.92)),var(--evidence-bg);background-size:cover;background-position:center;filter:saturate(.9);animation:slowPan 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.evidenceUniverse::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 0 1px,transparent 1px 4px);opacity:.18;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.evidenceTopline,.stripEyebrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;font:700 .7rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#bcd3d7;margin:0 0 10px}
.statusLamp{color:#98f1c5;font-weight:800}
.evidenceGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.37fr) minmax(0,.82fr);gap:17px;align-items:start}
.cinemaStage{border:1px solid rgba(140,240,224,.32);padding:11px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(4,14,20,.96),rgba(14,31,38,.95));border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 7px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.37)}
.cinemaPhoto{overflow:hidden;height:clamp(230px,30vh,365px);position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:9px;background:#031117;border:1px solid rgba(167,239,232,.3)}
.cinemaPhoto>img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;animation:cinemaMove 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate;filter:contrast(1.08)}
.cinemaSweep{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0 4px,rgba(154,242,236,.045) 5px,transparent 7px),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,20,25,.1),transparent 65%,rgba(2,20,25,.18));animation:scanShift 5s linear infinite}
.camOverlay{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;top:10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;font:800 .69rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#e2fffa;text-shadow:0 2px 5px black}
.liveDot{color:#ffa095;animation:recordBlink 2.3s infinite}
@keyframes cinemaMove{0%{transform:scale(1.01) translateX(0)}100%{transform:scale(1.075) translateX(-1.8%)}}@keyframes scanShift{to{background-position:0 40px,0 0}}@keyframes recordBlink{0%,75%,100%{opacity:1}85%{opacity:.3}}
.reelFooter{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:10px;color:#aac6cb;font:700 .64rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em}
.playLine{width:28%;height:3px;background:rgba(179,230,231,.16);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.playLine i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:28%;background:#a8f0d7;animation:scrub 6s linear infinite}@keyframes scrub{to{left:100%}}
.exhibitRail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
.exhibitTile{background:rgba(8,23,29,.88);color:#dfedef;text-align:left;padding:0;border:1px solid rgba(176,227,231,.25);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .16s,border-color .16s,box-shadow .16s}
.exhibitTile:hover,.exhibitTile.chosen{border-color:#93efdc;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(151,239,220,.3);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.exhibitTile.examined{border-color:rgba(132,221,164,.52)}
.tilePhoto{height:105px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#0a1c25}
.tilePhoto img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .3s}.exhibitTile:hover img{transform:scale(1.07)}
.tileSweep{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.3;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 22%,rgba(195,255,243,.35) 48%,transparent 57%);transform:translateX(-160%);animation:tileSweep 6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes tileSweep{to{transform:translateX(160%)}}
.tileNumber,.tileStatus{position:absolute;left:7px;padding:3px 5px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(1,12,19,.9);font:700 .6rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#d7eeea}
.tileNumber{top:7px}.tileStatus{bottom:6px;color:#9deacb}.tileDesc{padding:8px 9px;font-size:.69rem;font-weight:750;min-height:49px}
.interpretCard{padding:16px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(24,51,61,.94),rgba(11,24,31,.97));border:1px solid rgba(155,231,225,.28);border-radius:15px}
.interpretCard h3{font-size:1.22rem;margin:8px 0}.interpretCard p{line-height:1.6;font-size:.92rem;color:#e1eff0}
.evidenceSmall{font-size:.81rem;color:#a9c7cb;line-height:1.55;margin-top:10px}
.lexRow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:15px}
.lexToken{border:1px solid rgba(167,224,225,.23);padding:6px 8px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(5,15,21,.48);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:.73rem;color:#ebf7f6}
.lexToken>span{color:#a3ebda}
.interpretArea{margin-top:12px}.evidenceLocked,.evidenceVerified,.findingControls,.witnessConsequence{padding:14px;border:1px solid rgba(154,229,216,.27);border-radius:15px;background:rgba(6,19,25,.84)}
.evidenceLocked{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.evidenceLocked p{font-size:.81rem;color:#c2d9dc}.lockGlyph{font-size:2.4rem;color:var(--accent)}
.findingControls h3{font-size:1.03rem}.findingControls p{font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.5;color:#c4d9dd}
.analysisOption{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:left;width:100%;padding:10px;margin-top:8px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(18,42,51,.92);border:1px solid rgba(188,239,231,.24);font-size:.83rem;line-height:1.4;color:#f0fbff}
.analysisOption:hover{background:rgba(27,69,73,.95);border-color:#91efce}
.pickHalo{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(197,238,236,.38);border-radius:50%;width:23px;height:23px;flex:none;color:#d4f5e8}
.evidenceWarning{background:rgba(100,38,28,.7);color:#ffcdc3;border-left:3px solid #faad8d;padding:10px 12px;font-size:.8rem;margin-top:10px;border-radius:5px}
.evidenceVerified{background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(19,70,55,.72),rgba(6,19,25,.94));border-color:rgba(129,234,174,.57)}
.caseFooter{display:flex;gap:15px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:13px;border-top:1px solid rgba(177,230,226,.17);padding-top:12px;font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.5;color:#abc8c8}
.caseFooter span{max-width:75ch}
.measurementFeed{position:absolute;inset:40px 5% 10px;border:1px solid rgba(108,241,221,.54);border-radius:13px;background:rgba(2,9,14,.87);padding:11px 15px;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(72,205,190,.18)}
.signalTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:.66rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#b8e8da}.ledLight{width:9px;height:9px;background:#70f7aa;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 12px #76ffbc;animation:recordBlink 1.9s infinite}
.liveTiming{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 65px 1fr;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:12px;margin-top:19px}.liveTiming span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font:.66rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#c2d7db}.liveTiming b{font:900 clamp(1.2rem,2.1vw,2.4rem) ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#8dffde;text-shadow:0 0 13px rgba(111,235,208,.42)}.liveTiming i{font-size:.78rem;color:#ffc9aa;font-style:normal}.digitPulse{animation:clockPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}.digitPulse.delayed{animation-delay:1s}@keyframes clockPulse{50%{opacity:.66;text-shadow:none}}
.tinyCaption{font:.65rem/1.4 ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;color:#afc9cd;text-align:center;margin-top:20px}
/* witness with portrait, physical supporting exhibits and immersive interview */
.witnessUniverse{padding-top:0}.witnessScene{height:260px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;position:relative;margin:0 -20px 15px;overflow:hidden;animation:slowPan 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.witnessScene::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-8%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 18% 28%,rgba(138,246,219,.18),transparent 26%),radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%,rgba(112,186,255,.14),transparent 20%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05),transparent 25%,transparent 70%,rgba(0,0,0,.12));mix-blend-mode:screen;opacity:.9;animation:fogDrift 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;pointer-events:none}
.witnessVignette{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#081c24,rgba(4,15,22,.4)),radial-gradient(circle at 25% 50%,rgba(7,24,30,.1),rgba(4,12,19,.6))}
.characterFrame{position:absolute;left:22px;bottom:13px;display:flex;align-items:end;gap:18px;max-width:86%;color:white}
.portraitDraw{width:156px;height:184px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;filter:drop-shadow(0 16px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.55));background:linear-gradient(135deg,#12323c,#06161c);border:2px solid #8cead6;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08) inset,0 0 24px rgba(112,220,206,.18);overflow:hidden}.portraitDraw.photoPortrait{animation:portraitBreath 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.characterFrame h2{font-size:1.5rem;margin:5px 0}.characterFrame p{font-size:.85rem;color:#d5e3ea}
.witnessSignal{position:absolute;right:18px;bottom:18px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;height:38px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(3,12,18,.34);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}.witnessSignal i{width:4px;background:#95f6df;border-radius:3px;animation:waves 1.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;height:20px;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(149,246,223,.45)}.witnessSignal i:nth-child(2n){animation-delay:.4s;height:34px}.witnessSignal i:nth-child(3n){animation-delay:.8s;height:14px}@keyframes waves{to{height:6px;opacity:.45}}@keyframes slowPan{0%{background-position:48% 52%}100%{background-position:54% 46%}}@keyframes fogDrift{0%{transform:translateX(-2%) translateY(0) scale(1)}100%{transform:translateX(2%) translateY(-2%) scale(1.05)}}@keyframes portraitBreath{0%{transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}100%{transform:scale(1.025) translateY(-2px)}}
.witnessLayout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:16px}
.testimonyCard,.witnessDecision{padding:14px 16px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(179,229,221,.2);background:rgba(9,23,30,.88)}
.testimonyCard blockquote{font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.6;color:#f0fcfb;margin:9px 0;padding-left:15px;border-left:3px solid #91e7d1}
.testimonyCard p{font-size:.82rem;color:#abc9d0;line-height:1.55}
.witnessProps{padding:13px;margin-top:11px;background:rgba(9,23,30,.84);border-radius:14px}
.witnessProps>div:last-child{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.witnessProps button{padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#0a1c23;border:1px solid rgba(180,232,233,.25);border-radius:8px;color:#c2ebdd;font:.69rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
.witnessProps img{width:100%;height:82px;object-fit:cover;display:block}.witnessProps button span{display:block;padding:6px}
.witnessChoices p{font-size:.81rem;color:#bcd1d5}.miniStatRow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}.miniMeter{display:inline-flex;gap:5px;font-size:.72rem;background:#153444;border:1px solid #456e76;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:8px;color:#e9f6f3}.miniMeter b{color:#95eed4}
/* documents are actual distinct reading artifacts, not wall-of-text modals */
.documentUniverse{padding:16px 20px 20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0b252c,#06151b)}
.documentGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.68fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:18px;align-items:start}
.documentSceneThumb{height:220px;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;border:1px solid #608a8f;background:#0b171f}
.documentSceneThumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;animation:cinemaMove 13s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.documentSceneThumb .scan{position:absolute;inset:0}
.documentArtifact{margin-top:10px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.documentArtifact img{width:100%;height:120px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid rgba(226,248,240,.22)}
.documentPaper{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8efd8,#e8dbc5);color:#27333b;padding:20px 23px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid #d0bfa6;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #0007}
.documentPaper header{all:unset;display:block;padding:0 0 13px;border-bottom:2px solid #9b9b83;color:#293744}
.documentPaper h3{font:800 1.28rem Georgia,serif;margin:8px 0}.documentPaper li{margin-bottom:10px;font:1.02rem/1.56 Georgia,serif}.documentPaper .eyebrow{color:#637477}.documentPaper .meta{color:#67787c;margin-bottom:10px}
.documentPaper .keyline{padding:12px;background:rgba(222,206,150,.42);border-left:4px solid #c3a55e;font-size:.9rem}
/* map + scene: lower chrome, richer art, humanoid explorer, readable floating captions */
.mapBack{background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important;filter:saturate(1.08)}
.mapWrap{background:#06151c}
.avatar{width:46px;height:67px;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;background:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 7px #0009);z-index:8}
.avatar:after{display:none}.explorerSprite{width:46px;height:67px}.avatar.walking .walkerLegs{transform-origin:center 35px;animation:walker 0.44s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes walker{to{transform:skew(-7deg) rotate(9deg)}}
.routeLegend{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:3px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;pointer-events:none}.routeLegend span{font:.62rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;background:rgba(5,17,23,.86);padding:6px;border-radius:7px;color:#a9e5d8}
.node>div{width:37px;height:37px;font-size:.74rem}.node span:not(.chapterBadge){font-size:.64rem;width:100px;margin-left:-31px;margin-top:5px;text-align:center;background:rgba(3,13,18,.82);border-radius:6px;padding:3px;line-height:1.2}
.node.current>div{box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(130,248,206,.65),0 0 0 4px rgba(10,33,34,.4)}.node.locked{opacity:.45}
.hotspot{padding:5px 8px;border-radius:13px;max-width:175px;background:rgba(5,17,24,.83);font-size:.67rem;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.hotspot .orb{width:28px;height:28px;font-size:1.2rem}.hotspot:hover{box-shadow:0 0 21px rgba(155,245,221,.48),0 0 0 4px rgba(8,19,26,.36)}
.hotspot[data-kind='clue']{border-color:#e5d48e}.hotspot[data-kind='person']{border-color:#a0b8f0}
.worldLore{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:71px;z-index:4;max-width:370px;background:rgba(3,14,20,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);padding:11px 13px;border-left:3px solid #a1eed9;border-radius:8px;pointer-events:none}
.worldLore p{font-size:.77rem;line-height:1.45;color:#d4e4e9}
.worldAftermath{position:absolute;right:14px;top:146px;z-index:4;max-width:240px;background:rgba(9,28,34,.83);border:1px solid #b7bc85;padding:9px;border-radius:9px;font-size:.7rem;pointer-events:none}
.worldAftermath>span{font-weight:800;color:#f5dc97}.worldAftermath p{font-size:.71rem;line-height:1.4}
.storyDanger::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;border:2px solid rgba(255,89,64,.35);animation:alarmShimmer 5s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes alarmShimmer{50%{box-shadow:inset 0 0 60px rgba(245,69,59,.20)}}
@media(max-width:1050px){.evidenceGrid,.witnessLayout,.documentGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cinemaPhoto{overflow:hidden;height:250px}.caseFooter{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.worldLore{max-width:55%;bottom:100px}.worldAftermath{display:none}}
@media(max-width:650px){.evidenceUniverse{padding:12px}.exhibitRail{gap:5px}.tilePhoto{height:76px}.tileNumber{font-size:.48rem}.tileDesc{font-size:.57rem}.liveTiming{gap:4px}.dialogBody{max-height:78vh;overflow:auto}.characterFrame h2{font-size:1.08rem}.worldLore{display:none}.hotspot span:not(.orb){display:none}}
/* QA polish: the map remains navigable without overlapping labels. */
.arrival{display:none!important}
.mapFooter>div:nth-child(2){display:none!important}
.routeLegend{display:none!important}
.mapFooter{justify-content:flex-end}
.mapFooter .infoCard{background:rgba(6,20,26,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(9px)}
.node span:not(.chapterBadge){display:none}
.node.current span:not(.chapterBadge),.node:hover span:not(.chapterBadge),.node:focus-visible span:not(.chapterBadge){display:block}
.node.locked .chapterBadge{display:none}
/* The location already describes the story. Do not cover interactive objects with a second caption. */
.worldLore{display:none!important}

.measurementFeed{background:#03131c!important}


/* Original game-specific cinematic rebuild — does not import Far Horizon art. */
.sceneBg{filter:saturate(.90) contrast(1.06) brightness(.83);animation:originalSceneMove 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate;background-position:center center!important}
@keyframes originalSceneMove{from{transform:scale(1.055) translate(0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.105) translate(-1.3%,.85%)}}
.viewport:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 40%,transparent 35%,rgba(1,9,14,.22) 84%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,9,15,.2),transparent 26%,transparent 74%,rgba(2,8,13,.48));z-index:2}
.viewportTop,.hotspot,.sceneBottom{z-index:8!important}.viewportTop .titleCard{max-width:min(52%,480px)!important;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(4,14,21,.91),rgba(4,14,21,.62))!important;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);box-shadow:0 8px 26px #0007}.viewportTop .titleCard h2{font-size:1.45rem!important}.viewportTop .infoCard{max-width:285px!important;background:rgba(5,15,21,.83)}
.sceneBottom{pointer-events:none!important}.sceneBottom>*{pointer-events:auto!important}.sceneBottom .titleCard{max-width:min(360px,49%)!important;padding:9px 11px!important;background:rgba(3,13,20,.79)!important}.sceneBottom .titleCard p{font-size:.78rem!important}.sceneBottom .titleCard .eyebrow{display:none!important}
.hotspot{background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(7,24,32,.92),rgba(9,31,42,.82))!important;max-width:215px!important;padding:5px 8px 5px 5px!important;border:1px solid rgba(199,249,232,.58)!important;border-radius:11px!important;font-size:.72rem!important;box-shadow:0 3px 10px #0008,0 0 22px rgba(10,26,37,.4)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);transition:transform .14s,filter .14s;line-height:1.25!important}
.hotspot .orb{display:none!important}.hotspot .hotThumb{display:block;width:48px;height:46px;border-radius:7px;object-fit:cover;flex:0 0 48px;border:1px solid rgba(202,240,228,.43);filter:saturate(1.1) contrast(1.02)}.hotspot:hover .hotThumb{filter:saturate(1.3) contrast(1.08)}.hotspot:hover{z-index:30!important;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.035)!important}
.hotspot .pulseRing{inset:-4px!important;border-color:rgba(153,236,210,.45)!important;border-radius:12px!important;animation:originalPulse 3s infinite}@keyframes originalPulse{0%{opacity:.55;transform:scale(.97)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.12)}}
.witnessScene{height:285px!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important;animation:originalWitnessMove 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate!important}.witnessScene:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 12%,rgba(140,246,230,.16),transparent 27%),radial-gradient(circle at 83% 58%,rgba(238,159,101,.13),transparent 23%);animation:originalFog 14s infinite alternate;pointer-events:none}.witnessVignette{background:linear-gradient(0deg,#06161e,rgba(4,14,20,.28) 60%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(3,14,20,.45),transparent 70%)!important}.characterFrame{max-width:92%!important;left:22px!important;bottom:14px!important;z-index:5!important}.portraitDraw{width:182px!important;height:214px!important;object-fit:cover!important;object-position:center top!important;border-radius:15px!important;border:2px solid rgba(194,250,222,.82)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(3,15,22,.47),0 18px 38px #0009!important}.characterFrame h2{font-size:clamp(1.25rem,2vw,1.8rem)!important;text-shadow:0 2px 9px #000}.characterFrame p{color:#dce9e8!important}.witnessSignal{z-index:5!important}
@keyframes originalWitnessMove{0%{background-position:46% 47%}100%{background-position:54% 53%}}@keyframes originalFog{0%{opacity:.4;transform:translateX(-2%)}100%{opacity:.8;transform:translateX(2%)}}
.cinemaPhoto{isolation:isolate}.cinemaPhoto .measurementFeed{display:none!important}.cinemaPhoto>img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;animation:originalClueZoom 13s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes originalClueZoom{from{transform:scale(1.01)}to{transform:scale(1.055)}}.cinemaPhoto .camOverlay{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,12,18,.57),transparent 70%)!important}.exhibitTile .tilePhoto img{filter:saturate(.93) contrast(1.07)}.evidenceUniverse:before{filter:saturate(.93) contrast(1.07)!important}.evidenceUniverse:after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.022) 0 1px,transparent 1px 5px);opacity:.24}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sceneBg,.witnessScene,.cinemaPhoto>img,.witnessScene:before{animation:none!important}.hotspot .pulseRing{display:none!important}}
@media(max-width:760px){.portraitDraw{width:112px!important;height:138px!important}.witnessScene{height:208px!important}.hotspot{max-width:165px!important;font-size:.69rem!important}.hotspot .hotThumb{width:38px;height:38px;flex-basis:38px}.viewportTop .infoCard{display:none!important}}


/* ===== 2026 cinematic rebuild — assets remain independent of Far Horizon ===== */
:root{--accent-glow:rgba(133,236,213,.2)}
body{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -15%,#1b3742 0%,#071017 60%,#04080b 100%);text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}
.btn,.chip,.entry,.tab,.hotspot{transition:background-color .22s,border-color .22s,box-shadow .22s,transform .22s}
.viewport{isolation:isolate;min-height:min(73vh,760px);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 25px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.54)}
.sceneBg{inset:-1.2%;background-size:cover;background-position:center center;transform:scale(1.07);filter:saturate(1.1) contrast(1.07);animation:cinemaBreath 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes cinemaBreath{0%{transform:scale(1.07) translate(0,0)}100%{transform:scale(1.115) translate(-.8%,-.6%)}}
.sceneAtmosphere{pointer-events:none;position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;overflow:hidden}
.sceneAtmosphere .beam{position:absolute;width:35%;height:100%;top:-10%;left:65%;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent,rgba(242,225,158,.05),transparent);transform:skewX(-14deg);animation:lightCreep 19s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes lightCreep{to{transform:translateX(-80px) skewX(-14deg);opacity:.45}}
.sceneAtmosphere .moisture{position:absolute;inset:-30%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 14% 33%,rgba(190,232,255,.07),transparent 16%),radial-gradient(circle at 72% 62%,rgba(236,225,186,.07),transparent 20%);filter:blur(15px);animation:breathingMist 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes breathingMist{to{transform:translateX(50px) translateY(-20px)}}
.sceneAtmosphere.rain .rainlines{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(107deg,transparent 0px,transparent 18px,rgba(195,235,255,.17) 19px,transparent 20px,transparent 45px);background-size:160px 220px;opacity:.38;transform:skewY(-3deg);animation:rainFall .62s linear infinite}
@keyframes rainFall{to{background-position:70px 220px}}
.sceneAtmosphere.machine .ledstrip{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 89% 40%,rgba(242,95,83,.19),transparent 8%),radial-gradient(circle at 40% 65%,rgba(61,225,241,.17),transparent 18%);animation:warningPulse 3s infinite alternate}
@keyframes warningPulse{to{opacity:.3}}
.sceneAtmosphere .subtlegrain{position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 2px,rgba(255,255,255,.015) 3px,transparent 4px);opacity:.3;mix-blend-mode:soft-light}
.sceneBg+.fog,.sceneBg+.scan{opacity:.3}
.viewportTop{left:18px;top:18px;right:18px;align-items:flex-start}
.viewportTop .titleCard{max-width:42%;min-width:230px;padding:13px 17px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(3,14,20,.91),rgba(7,18,26,.73));border-radius:12px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent);box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.viewportTop .titleCard h2{font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.18;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:.2em 0 .3em}
.viewportTop .titleCard p{font-size:.84rem;max-width:36ch;line-height:1.55}
.viewportTop .infoCard{max-width:32ch;padding:13px 15px;background:rgba(4,13,19,.76);border-left:2px solid rgba(170,233,232,.7)}
.viewportTop .infoCard .chip{font-size:.67rem}
.hotspot{max-width:180px;border:1px solid rgba(201,249,244,.43);background:rgba(4,15,21,.75);border-radius:9px;padding:7px 8px;box-shadow:0 9px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4);font-size:.73rem;text-shadow:0 1px 6px #0007;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.hotspot .hotThumb{width:44px;height:43px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid rgba(208,250,242,.3)}
.hotspot:hover,.hotspot:focus-visible{border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(7,26,33,.98);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.08);box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(130,238,219,.25)}
.hotspot .pulseRing{opacity:.4;inset:-5px;animation:pulse 3s infinite}
.sceneBottom{left:14px;right:14px;bottom:12px;align-items:end;pointer-events:none}
.sceneBottom>*{pointer-events:auto}
.sceneBottom .titleCard{width:340px;max-width:35%!important;background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(5,14,20,.94),rgba(8,19,24,.83));padding:10px 12px}
.sceneBottom .titleCard p{max-height:55px;overflow-y:auto;font-size:.77rem;line-height:1.38}
.sceneBottom .titleCard .btn{font-size:.67rem;padding:6px 7px}
.sceneBottom .chip{background:rgba(5,18,24,.82);font-size:.7rem}
.witnessScene{height:280px!important;animation:none!important;background-size:cover;background-position:center 42%;box-shadow:inset 0 -130px 85px rgba(3,12,18,.75)}
.witnessScene::before{animation:breathingMist 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;opacity:.55}
.characterFrame{align-items:flex-end;bottom:0;left:25px;gap:20px}
.characterFrame .portraitDraw{height:235px!important;width:184px!important;object-fit:cover!important;object-position:center 23%!important;border-radius:13px 13px 0 0!important;border-bottom:0!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.6)) saturate(1.12)!important;box-shadow:0 -2px 30px rgba(144,230,220,.14)}
.characterFrame h2{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.1vw,2rem);line-height:1.14;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #000}
.characterFrame p{text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000}
.witnessSignal{opacity:.46}
.cinemaPhoto>img{animation:cinemaBreath 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate;filter:contrast(1.05) saturate(1.08)}
.cinemaPhoto{border-radius:14px;height:clamp(270px,36vh,425px);box-shadow:0 15px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.34)}
.cinemaStage{background:rgba(7,18,25,.95);border-radius:16px}
.evidenceGrid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.42fr) minmax(0,.8fr);gap:14px}
.measurementInset{position:absolute;left:11px;right:11px;bottom:12px;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-start;pointer-events:none}
.measurementInset .recordTag{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;background:rgba(4,13,18,.82);border:1px solid rgba(209,251,242,.18);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.24);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;max-width:45%;min-width:80px}
.measurementInset .recordTag small{color:#99bbc0;font-size:.59rem;letter-spacing:.12em}
.measurementInset .recordTag b{color:#d5fff6;font-size:.9rem;max-width:100%;word-wrap:break-word}
.measurementInset .recordTag.alert{border-color:rgba(255,171,153,.52)}
.evidenceUniverse{font-size:.94rem}
.testimonyCard{line-height:1.55}
.testimonyCard blockquote{line-height:1.58}
.paper{box-shadow:0 5px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.3),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35);font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif',serif;line-height:1.72}
.paper h3{font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1.3;color:#1c2b32;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.paper .meta{font-family:Consolas,monospace;line-height:1.5}
.paper li{padding:.27em 0}
.paper.doc-chat{background:#d8e7e9;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}.paper.doc-chat li{background:#fff;border-radius:13px 13px 13px 2px;margin:8px 0;padding:9px 13px;list-style:none;max-width:95%;box-shadow:0 3px 11px #102b3015}.paper.doc-chat ul{padding-left:6px}
.paper.doc-email,.paper.doc-letter,.paper.doc-memo{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f6f1e8,#e7e5db)}
.paper.doc-log,.paper.doc-table,.paper.doc-budget,.paper.doc-measurement{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#e2e5e6,#d0d9dc);font-size:.91rem}
.paper.doc-log li,.paper.doc-table li,.paper.doc-budget li,.paper.doc-measurement li{border-bottom:1px dashed #6d7b8290;list-style:none;padding:9px}
.paper.doc-poster,.paper.doc-notice{border-top:9px solid #c58e63;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f8edcb,#e9d8a9);font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}
.paper.doc-transcript{border-left:9px solid #6d8ca0}
.paper.doc-diary{font-style:italic;background:#f2e5d3}
.storyPulse{position:absolute;z-index:3;top:17%;right:18px;border:1px solid #a3f4df80;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#0b2429aa;font:600 .62rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);pointer-events:none}
.storyPulse:before{content:'●';margin-right:6px;color:var(--accent);animation:warningPulse 2s infinite alternate}
@media (max-width:1100px){.viewportTop .titleCard{max-width:65%}.sceneBottom .titleCard{max-width:55%!important}.witnessScene{height:240px!important}}
@media (max-width:650px){.viewportTop .titleCard{max-width:80%;min-width:0}.viewportTop .infoCard{display:none}.hotspot .hotThumb{display:none}.hotspot{font-size:.67rem;max-width:130px}.sceneBottom .titleCard{display:none}.evidenceGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sceneBg,.sceneAtmosphere *, .portraitDraw,.cinemaPhoto>img{animation:none!important}}


/* FINAL-ART WORKBENCH: cinematic scene adjustments, no gameplay changes */
.sceneBg{background-repeat:no-repeat;filter:contrast(1.05) saturate(.97);will-change:transform}
.hotspot{box-shadow:0 14px 26px #0007,0 0 0 1px rgba(193,252,239,.18) inset}
.hotspot:hover{box-shadow:0 16px 32px #0009,0 0 18px rgba(149,242,214,.28)}
.hotspot .orb{filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3))}
.viewportTop .titleCard{max-width:44%;padding:10px 13px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(4,15,19,.86),rgba(12,29,36,.78))}
.viewportTop .titleCard h2{font-size:clamp(1.18rem,2vw,1.65rem)}
.viewportTop .titleCard p{max-width:40ch;line-height:1.46}
.sceneBottom .titleCard{max-width:340px!important;max-height:160px;overflow:auto;padding:10px 12px}
.sceneBottom .titleCard p{font-size:.79rem;line-height:1.45}
.cinemaPhoto img,.exhibitTile img{object-fit:cover}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sceneBg,.fog,.water,.drift,.flicker,.cinemaPhoto img,.photoPortrait{animation:none!important}}

/* Final cinematic composition — environmental photography remains uncovered. */
:root{--panel:rgba(7,20,28,.96);--line:rgba(170,236,225,.23)}
.viewport{min-height:675px;box-shadow:0 24px 65px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}
.viewport .sceneBg{filter:saturate(1.05) contrast(1.05);animation:pan 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.viewportTop{top:17px;left:18px;right:18px;pointer-events:none}
.viewportTop>div{pointer-events:auto}
.viewportTop .titleCard{max-width:48%;background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(4,14,19,.92),rgba(8,25,32,.73));box-shadow:0 14px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.viewportTop .titleCard h2{font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2vw,1.7rem)}
.viewportTop .infoCard{max-width:290px;background:rgba(4,15,22,.77)}
.viewport .sceneBottom{pointer-events:none}
.viewport .sceneBottom>*{pointer-events:auto}
.viewport .sceneBottom .titleCard{max-width:335px!important;background:linear-gradient(130deg,rgba(4,14,19,.96),rgba(11,30,37,.87));padding:9px 12px}
.viewport .sceneBottom .titleCard p{font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.32}
.viewport .sceneBottom .titleCard .eyebrow{font-size:.59rem}
.viewport .sceneBottom .titleCard .btn{font-size:.71rem;padding:7px 9px}
.hotspot{display:flex;max-width:184px!important;min-height:54px!important;gap:8px!important;padding:7px 9px!important;border:1px solid rgba(224,255,242,.47)!important;border-radius:13px!important;background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(3,18,23,.92),rgba(10,35,40,.76))!important;box-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 17px rgba(123,244,210,.12)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(9px)}
.hotspot img.hotThumb{width:42px!important;height:42px!important;object-fit:cover;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid rgba(196,252,231,.28)}
.hotspot>span:not(.pulseRing){font-size:.69rem;line-height:1.12;max-width:116px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.hotspot:hover,.hotspot:focus-visible{z-index:12!important;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.06)!important;background:rgba(8,34,38,.98)!important;outline:2px solid var(--accent)}
.mapWrap{background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important}
.mapWrap::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(3,14,20,.28),rgba(3,14,20,.15));pointer-events:none}
.mapBack{filter:opacity(.4)}
.node{z-index:6}.node>div{background:rgba(4,19,22,.87)}.node.current>div{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(2,13,17,.42),0 0 25px rgba(114,250,205,.5)}
.evidenceUniverse{border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}
.cinemaPhoto{background:#061921}.cinemaPhoto img{object-fit:cover;filter:contrast(1.04)}
.witnessScene{height:310px!important;background-position:center 46%}
.witnessVignette{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(3,11,16,.88),transparent 65%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(4,12,17,.7),transparent 64%)}
.characterFrame{align-items:end!important;gap:16px!important}
.portraitDraw{width:174px!important;height:212px!important;object-fit:cover!important;border:3px solid rgba(184,255,233,.63)!important;border-radius:14px!important;box-shadow:0 13px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.66)}
.testimonyCard blockquote{font-size:1.05rem!important;line-height:1.52}
.modal.open .dialog{width:min(1180px,95vw);border:1px solid rgba(155,240,224,.28);box-shadow:0 24px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.evidenceGrid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.12fr) minmax(320px,.88fr)}
.evidenceUniverse .cinemaPhoto{height:340px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.viewport .sceneBottom .titleCard{max-width:250px!important}.evidenceGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.sceneBg,.fog,.drift,.water,.flicker,.cinemaSweep,.portraitDraw{animation:none!important}}

/* Scene label contrast hardening */
.viewport .sceneBottom .chip.active{background:#8fe6c6!important;color:#03141c!important;border:1px solid rgba(231,255,249,.8)!important;font-weight:800!important;opacity:1!important;}
body:has(.brand h1) .viewport .hotspot:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff!important;outline-offset:4px;}

/* Classroom-safe, compact audio control panel. All controls remain accessible offline. */
.audioSettings{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto}
.audioHeading{color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:900;font-size:.77rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.audioDescription{font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.55;color:#d6e8ec;margin:0 0 17px}
.audioTiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.audioTile{background:linear-gradient(155deg,rgba(30,55,65,.8),rgba(9,24,34,.9));padding:15px 16px;border:1px solid rgba(182,236,244,.22);border-radius:16px}
.audioTileTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;min-height:78px}
.audioTile h3{font-size:1rem;margin:6px 0 12px;max-width:23ch}
.audioTile label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;color:#dceef0;font-size:.83rem;font-weight:650;margin:12px 0 6px}
.audioTile input[type=range]{accent-color:var(--accent);width:100%;height:24px;cursor:pointer}
.audioTrackInfo{font-size:.78rem;color:#9db7bd;line-height:1.5;margin-top:10px}
.audioActions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
.audioFootnote{margin:16px 0 2px;color:#96b0b6;font-size:.77rem}
@media(max-width:720px){.audioTiles{grid-template-columns:1fr}.audioTileTop{min-height:unset}}

/* NEXT GEN GAMEPLAY STYLE */
/* Next-Generation 2026 edition — original approved game remains under this additive layer */
:root{--ng-glass:rgba(6,18,25,.96)}
header .brand .eyebrow{letter-spacing:.22em;color:#fad49b}
header{box-shadow:0 16px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.brand h1{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.015em;font-size:clamp(1.1rem,1.6vw,1.6rem);text-shadow:0 2px 20px #000}
.pane{min-width:0}
.ng-mission-pill{border:1px solid rgba(231,209,162,.44);background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(42,62,67,.88),rgba(12,30,42,.94));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:13px;margin:0 0 13px;box-shadow:0 12px 38px #0004}
.ng-mission-pill strong{font-size:.95rem;display:block}.ng-mission-pill small{color:#f0d2ac;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em}.ng-mission-pill .btn{flex-shrink:0}
.ng-hotspot{position:absolute;z-index:10;right:4%;bottom:16%;padding:10px 13px;max-width:215px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#0b2028f5,#13343aed);border:1px solid #e8d6a17d;box-shadow:0 13px 32px #000b;border-radius:10px;color:#f7f4e9;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;animation:ngBeacon 3s infinite}
.ng-hotspot:focus-visible,.ng-hardware button:focus-visible,.ng-tools button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffd08d;outline-offset:4px}
.ng-hotspot .ng-icon{display:block;font-size:1.55rem;line-height:1}.ng-hotspot strong{display:block;font-size:.83rem}.ng-hotspot small{display:block;font-size:.68rem;color:#d4dfdc;line-height:1.3}
.ng-world-prop{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:4%;bottom:5%;border:1px solid rgba(227,220,185,.48);border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(8,22,27,.94),rgba(16,36,40,.87));color:#f6eacb;max-width:min(48%,280px);padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:0 10px 40px #0009;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.ng-world-prop strong{display:block;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.06em}.ng-world-prop span{font-size:.74rem;line-height:1.4;display:block;margin-top:5px}.ng-world-prop.good{border-color:#9bdeb7}.ng-world-prop.warning{border-color:#ecb078}
.ng-state-beam{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;inset:0;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(5,39,48,.05) 25%,transparent 50%);transition:.45s}
.ng-state-beam.flood{background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(30,109,139,.53) 0%,rgba(23,92,124,.15) 38%,transparent 55%);animation:ngWater 5s infinite alternate ease-in-out}
.ng-state-beam.clear{background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(35,121,87,.24),transparent 26%)}
.ng-state-beam.blackout{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.62),rgba(30,6,13,.1))}
.ng-state-beam.corrected{background:linear-gradient(110deg,rgba(35,129,117,.18),transparent 47%)}
@keyframes ngWater{0%{opacity:.75}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-3px)}}
@keyframes ngBeacon{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 10px #e8d6a130,0 13px 32px #000b}50%{box-shadow:0 0 25px #e8d6a15a,0 13px 32px #000b}}
.ng-map-flag{display:block;border-radius:7px;padding:5px;background:rgba(8,26,33,.92);color:#fae1ad;font:700 .61rem/1.2 Arial,sans-serif;text-align:center;max-width:150px;margin:5px auto 0}
.ng-modal{--ng-bg:#08151c;color:#eff4ee}.ng-modal .ng-head{border-bottom:1px solid #e0c99552;padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:flex-end}.ng-modal .ng-head h2{margin:2px 0;font:700 clamp(1.25rem,2vw,1.7rem) Georgia,serif}.ng-modal .ng-sub{color:#aec2c8;line-height:1.55;font-size:.94rem}.ng-modal small.label{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#eacb91;text-transform:uppercase}
.ng-deck{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(250px,.85fr);gap:16px;align-items:stretch}
.ng-instrument,.ng-form{background:linear-gradient(148deg,#102633,#07131b);border:1px solid #5a747d8c;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 0 45px #0006;min-width:0}
.ng-instrument{padding:16px}.ng-form{padding:17px;background:linear-gradient(142deg,#172b34,#0c1b25)}
.ng-metal{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#24414b 0px,#31525c 2px,#1a3640 4px);border:7px ridge #54717a;box-shadow:inset 0 0 40px #000a,0 16px 25px #0008;border-radius:13px;padding:14px}
.ng-dial{font:700 2.5rem ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#bbebd4;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 0 18px #43d29b60}.ng-dial.amber{color:#f4c68d;text-shadow:0 0 14px #f3a94866}
.ng-mono{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.8rem;color:#b2d3d7}
.ng-hardware{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ng-hardware button,.ng-tools button{cursor:pointer;font:700 .78rem/1.35 Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;color:#e7eced;background:#17313c;border:1px solid #6f979a;padding:11px;border-radius:9px}.ng-hardware button.selected{background:#4e6651;color:#fff4d0;border-color:#d3c397;box-shadow:inset 0 0 13px #baae554c}
.ng-choicebox{border:1px solid #728d96;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin:10px 0;background:#0b1a22}.ng-choicebox h4{font-size:.8rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:8px;color:#deb894}.ng-choicebox .ng-hardware{margin-top:8px}
.ng-form label{display:block;font-size:.8rem;color:#ecddb7;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 5px}.ng-form textarea,.ng-form select,.ng-form input{border:1px solid #7b9497;border-radius:7px;background:#f4efe4;color:#1d2a2d;width:100%;padding:10px;font:500 .92rem/1.4 Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}.ng-form textarea{min-height:115px;resize:vertical}
.ng-form .ng-tools{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:13px}.ng-form .ng-tools .submit{background:#b9e0cb;color:#10242d;border-color:#b9e0cb}
.ng-feedback{margin-top:12px;border-left:4px solid #d6a869;background:#1b2b31;border-radius:3px;padding:10px;font-size:.83rem;line-height:1.4;color:#f4e2c8;min-height:38px}.ng-feedback.success{border-color:#8ed6aa;color:#cfecd7}
.ng-caption{font:.76rem/1.45 ui-monospace,monospace;color:#afc8cb;margin-top:9px}
.ng-chain{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:13px 0}.ng-chain i{flex:1;height:5px;background:#506c74;border-radius:3px}.ng-chain i.on{background:#94e4b3;box-shadow:0 0 12px #a1deab}
.ng-chain b{border:1px solid #8fb0a6;border-radius:20px;padding:10px;color:#ebded2;font:700 .79rem Arial}
.ng-frame{border:1px solid #8fc9b180;border-left:4px solid #a4dfbf;padding:9px 12px;margin-top:10px;border-radius:5px;background:#12303b;font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.5;color:#e2eee8}
.ng-gloss{display:inline-block;background:#203948;padding:4px 7px;color:#c6e9e4;font-size:.72rem;margin:2px;border-radius:5px}
.ng-evidence-thumb{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #69878a7b;margin:12px 0}
.ng-notes{margin-top:11px;font-size:.75rem;color:#aebbb7}
.ng-hero-ribbon{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;left:2.5%;top:2.8%;max-width:310px;z-index:5;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,19,27,.95),rgba(6,19,26,.45));border-left:3px solid #e4d4a3;border-radius:2px;padding:9px 14px;color:#fff6dc;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #000}
.ng-hero-ribbon b{font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.08em}.ng-hero-ribbon span{display:block;font-size:.7rem;color:#e1d3bb;margin-top:3px}
.ng-pulse-led{width:13px;height:13px;background:#e36b56;box-shadow:0 0 12px #e36b56;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}.ng-pulse-led.on{background:#8ed4a8;box-shadow:0 0 12px #8ed4a8}
.ng-sourceclip{font:700 .76rem/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace;color:#e8d6b4;background:#0b1c28;border:1px dashed #8b9290;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;margin:10px 0}
.ng-timeline{display:flex;justify-content:space-around;gap:10px;margin:15px 0}.ng-timeline>div{flex:1;background:#112c35;border:1px solid #6c949a;padding:13px 7px;border-radius:10px;text-align:center}.ng-timeline b{font:700 1.75rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#b5ece0;display:block}.ng-timeline small{letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:.64rem;color:#d3b991}
.ng-original-nav{display:block;width:100%;border-top:1px solid #729a9b4a;margin:20px 0 0;padding-top:10px;font-size:.8rem;color:#b2c4cc}
@media(max-width:1000px){.ng-deck{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ng-mission-pill{flex-wrap:wrap}.ng-world-prop{max-width:190px}}
@media(max-width:650px){.ng-mission-pill{padding:9px}.ng-mission-pill .btn{width:100%}.ng-hotspot{right:2%;bottom:8%;padding:8px;font-size:.7rem;max-width:155px}.ng-world-prop{left:2%;bottom:2%;max-width:48%;padding:7px}.ng-world-prop span{font-size:.65rem}.ng-deck{gap:10px}.ng-instrument,.ng-form{padding:10px}.ng-modal .ng-head{display:block}.ng-dial{font-size:1.9rem}.ng-timeline b{font-size:1.2rem}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ng-hotspot,.ng-state-beam{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

.ng-scan-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.ng-scan-pair figure{margin:0;min-width:0;background:#07151f;border:1px solid #759496;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden}.ng-scan-pair img{width:100%;height:150px;object-fit:contain;display:block}.ng-scan-pair figcaption{font-size:.66rem;color:#e2d0a6;padding:6px;background:#0f2d38;letter-spacing:.05em}
@media(max-width:600px){.ng-scan-pair img{height:100px}.ng-scan-pair figcaption{font-size:.55rem}}

.ng-fixture{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:3;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 14px #000b)}.ng-gate-fixture{height:32%;max-width:28%;left:31%;bottom:13%;opacity:.67;transform:perspective(500px) rotateY(-12deg)}.ng-gate-fixture.operational{opacity:.82;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 18px #4a9d7c70)}.ng-pump-fixture{width:18%;left:52%;top:38%;opacity:.8;transform:rotate(-10deg)}.ng-pump-fixture.operational{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #5fbb9d80)}.ng-lamp-fixture{width:27%;left:32%;top:19%}.ng-security-shutter{top:16%;left:34%;width:34%;height:45%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(82,94,102,.83) 0,rgba(82,94,102,.83) 9px,rgba(10,22,33,.88) 10px,rgba(10,22,33,.88) 15px);border:8px ridge #516572;transform:skewX(-4deg)}.ng-media-display,.ng-news-display{right:17%;top:22%;width:23%;height:27%;background:#122632e8;border:7px ridge #6a8896;box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px #000c,0 0 20px #000b;transform:perspective(400px) rotateY(-9deg);padding:12px}.ng-news-display{top:14%;right:20%;width:29%;height:27%}.ng-screen-led{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:#b75655;box-shadow:0 0 8px #cf554e}.operational .ng-screen-led{background:#78e7be;box-shadow:0 0 14px #78e7be}.danger .ng-screen-led{background:#e35f53}.ng-screen-line{height:9%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8eaaa9,#2e5a6f);margin:8% 0;border-radius:3px}.ng-screen-line.short{width:56%}.operational .ng-screen-line{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#81dabb,#447b73)}
@media(max-width:650px){.ng-gate-fixture{height:28%;left:25%}.ng-pump-fixture{width:27%;left:50%}.ng-media-display,.ng-news-display{right:15%;width:30%}}

.ng-scaffold{background:#09222c;border:1px solid #4f7881;border-left:4px solid #9cdbbb;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 14px;margin-top:15px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:start;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.45}.ng-scaffold>div{flex:1}.ng-scaffold b{color:#d4e9c4;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.12em}.ng-scaffold p{margin:5px 0}.ng-scaffold details{max-width:50%;flex:1;border-left:1px solid #395965;padding-left:12px}.ng-scaffold summary{color:#d8c9a0;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}@media(max-width:600px){.ng-scaffold{display:block}.ng-scaffold details{margin-top:10px;border-left:0;border-top:1px solid #395965;padding:10px 0 0;max-width:none}}


/* v3.2 interaction prototype: existing chapter scaffolds preserved; no external assets. */
.v32-task-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.24fr) minmax(310px,.85fr)!important;align-items:start;gap:18px!important}
.v32-photo-workbench{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#102430,#091720)!important;padding:0!important;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 22px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.v32-site-photo{position:relative;margin:0;min-height:250px;max-height:370px;overflow:hidden;background:#0c191e}
.v32-site-photo img{display:block;width:100%;height:clamp(240px,29vw,370px);object-fit:cover;object-position:center;filter:contrast(1.05) saturate(.96)}
.v32-site-photo:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(3,11,15,.82),transparent 35%,rgba(2,9,12,.12));pointer-events:none}
.v32-site-photo figcaption{position:absolute;z-index:1;left:15px;right:15px;bottom:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font:700 .67rem ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#eaf7ec;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #000}
.v32-hardware-paper{background:#e1d5b9;color:#282f2c;margin:14px;padding:17px 19px 15px;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:3px 6px 1px #050c118a;transform:rotate(-.28deg);font-family:Georgia,serif}
.v32-paper-title{font:900 .65rem ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#45504b}.v32-rule{border-top:1px solid #8d8a79;margin:8px 0}
.v32-measurements{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}.v32-measurements>div{border-bottom:2px solid #918b75;padding:8px 0}.v32-measurements small{display:block;letter-spacing:.1em;font:700 .69rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#484f4a}.v32-measurements strong{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3.3rem);font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.04em}.v32-measurements strong span{font-size:.36em;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-weight:500}.v32-paper-sub{color:#39433e;font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.4}.v32-real-world-note{font:700 .73rem ui-monospace,monospace;line-height:1.45;color:#71462d;border-top:1px dashed #ac9f88;margin-top:9px;padding-top:10px}
.v32-design-order{padding:10px 14px 0}.v32-design-order h4,.v32-controls h4{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.05em}.v32-receipt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 13px;margin-top:10px;background:#1e3e40;border-left:3px solid #d4b884;border-radius:2px;flex-wrap:wrap}.v32-receipt span{font:700 .63rem ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#bad8d1}.v32-receipt b{font:700 1.6rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#f2dfb9}.v32-receipt small{font:.66rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#dae3dd}
.v32-task-layout .ng-frame{margin:14px;background:#19353b;border-left:3px solid #c6decb}.v32-authorisation{border-radius:3px!important;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#1e3135,#112129)!important;box-shadow:0 14px 40px #0005}.v32-authorisation h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.3rem;margin:10px 0 16px;font-weight:600;color:#f2e7c9}.v32-authorisation textarea{min-height:145px}.v32-authorisation .ng-gloss{font-size:.68rem}
.v32-river-photo img{object-position:center 60%}.v32-pump-status{margin:14px;display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#291f20;padding:14px;border-left:4px solid #de9574}.v32-pump-status.safe{background:#173b35;border-color:#8cf0be}.v32-pump-status small{display:block;font:.64rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#bdc9ca;letter-spacing:.07em}.v32-pump-status strong{display:block;font:700 1.1rem ui-monospace,monospace;margin-top:5px}.v32-signalbar{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:end;height:35px}.v32-signalbar i{width:8px;display:block;height:12px;background:#dc997c;opacity:.55}.v32-signalbar i:nth-child(2){height:17px}.v32-signalbar i:nth-child(3){height:27px}.v32-signalbar i:nth-child(4){height:20px}.v32-signalbar i:nth-child(5){height:33px}.v32-pump-status.safe i{background:#8cf0be;opacity:1;animation:v32pulse 1.6s infinite alternate}@keyframes v32pulse{to{opacity:.5;transform:scaleY(.78)}}
.v32-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:12px 14px}.v32-controls .ng-choicebox{margin:0;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid #37515a;background:#11262e}.v32-controls .ng-hardware{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.v32-controls .ng-hardware button{flex:1;min-width:68px}.v32-sensor-note{padding:12px 14px;margin:0 14px;background:#152b33;border-top:1px dashed #6d7975;font:500 .77rem/1.45 ui-monospace,monospace;color:#d3dddc}
.v32-tool-kit{border:16px solid #293f43!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #a29174,0 14px 35px #0008;background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#1f3236,#1f3236 13px,#21383c 13px,#21383c 26px)!important;padding:15px!important}.v32-kit-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:700 .68rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#c9d3bd;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #667579}
.v32-parts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;padding:22px 0}.v32-part{border:2px solid #5e7c78;background:#102129;border-radius:8px;padding:13px 5px;text-align:center;box-shadow:inset 0 0 15px #061217}.v32-part-symbol{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,3rem);display:block;height:58px;color:#9db7b1}.v32-part.used{border-color:#ccbd81}.v32-part.glowing{border-color:#f2de98;box-shadow:0 0 20px #eac76950,inset 0 0 15px #f9bd5022}.v32-part.glowing .v32-part-symbol{color:#ffe39b;text-shadow:0 0 19px #ffc55d}.v32-part b,.v32-part small{display:block}.v32-part b{font:800 .72rem ui-monospace,monospace}.v32-part small{font:.62rem ui-monospace,monospace;margin-top:5px;color:#c1c6bb}.v32-cable{border-top:1px solid #4a5c5d;padding:12px;display:grid;gap:3px;font:500 .7rem ui-monospace,monospace}.v32-cable b{font-size:.85rem;color:#c8efda}.v32-evidence-notice{color:#d6e3dd;background:#20333b;border-left:3px solid #ddcaa0;padding:11px;line-height:1.45}
/* In-scene state is a readable physical notice, not a schematic floating across photographs. */
html[data-game='town'] .ng-world-prop{max-width:min(260px,32%)!important;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d1c4a7,#eee1c6)!important;color:#313531!important;border:2px solid #8b7a5c!important;border-radius:3px!important;box-shadow:3px 8px 12px #0008!important;font-family:Georgia,serif!important;transform:rotate(-1deg);bottom:20%!important;right:1%!important;left:auto!important;font-size:.76rem!important}html[data-game='town'] .ng-world-prop strong,html[data-game='town'] .ng-world-prop span{color:#343632!important}
@media(max-width:950px){.v32-task-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.v32-site-photo img{height:clamp(220px,38vw,350px)}.v32-authorisation textarea{min-height:120px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.v32-task-layout{gap:8px!important}.v32-hardware-paper{margin:8px;padding:12px}.v32-site-photo img{height:205px}.v32-measurements strong{font-size:2.1rem}.v32-receipt b{font-size:1.3rem}.v32-controls{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v32-tool-kit{border-width:8px!important;padding:9px!important}.v32-part{padding:8px 1px}.v32-part b{font-size:.59rem}.v32-part small{font-size:.55rem}.v32-part-symbol{height:40px}.v32-task-layout .ng-frame{font-size:.84rem!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v32-pump-status.safe i{animation:none}}

html[data-game='town'] .viewportTop .titleCard{max-width:260px!important;padding:8px 12px!important;background:rgba(5,15,19,.65)!important;border:1px solid rgba(235,241,228,.22)!important;box-shadow:0 5px 17px #0008}
html[data-game='town'] .viewportTop .titleCard p{display:none!important}
html[data-game='town'] .viewportTop .infoCard{display:none!important}
html[data-game='town'] .sceneBottom>.titleCard{max-width:165px!important;padding:6px 9px!important;background:rgba(5,15,19,.58)!important}
html[data-game='town'] .sceneBottom>.titleCard p,html[data-game='town'] .sceneBottom>.titleCard .eyebrow{display:none!important}
html[data-game='town'] .sceneBottom>.titleCard .btn{font-size:.63rem!important;padding:6px 7px!important}
html[data-game='town'] .hotspot{width:50px!important;height:50px!important;min-width:50px!important;max-width:50px!important;border-radius:50%!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;padding:0!important;background:radial-gradient(circle,#314b44aa,#04101599)!important;border:2px solid #b2e2ceaa!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #08181b44,0 0 19px #90e9c966!important;isolation:isolate;transition:scale .2s,background .2s!important}
html[data-game='town'] .hotspot .hotThumb{display:none!important}
html[data-game='town'] .hotspot:before{content:'⌕';display:block;color:#f7edd0;font:700 1.65rem Georgia,serif!important;line-height:1}
html[data-game='town'] .hotspot[data-kind='document']:before{content:'▤';font:700 1.25rem ui-monospace,monospace!important}
html[data-game='town'] .hotspot[data-kind='person']:before{content:'♟';font:700 1.35rem Georgia,serif!important}
html[data-game='town'] .hotspot span:not(.pulseRing){position:absolute!important;top:calc(100% + 8px)!important;left:50%!important;translate:-50% 0!important;display:none!important;width:max-content!important;max-width:160px!important;border-radius:5px!important;background:#081b1fe8!important;padding:7px 9px!important;font:700 .70rem/1.25 ui-monospace,monospace!important;color:#eff2df!important;white-space:normal!important;text-align:center!important;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0009}
html[data-game='town'] .hotspot:is(:hover,:focus-visible) span:not(.pulseRing){display:block!important}
html[data-game='town'] .hotspot:is(:hover,:focus-visible){scale:1.08}
html[data-game='town'] .ng-world-prop.warning{display:none!important} /* The paper warning covered the actual gate in the original screenshot. */
html[data-game='town'] .worldLore{display:none!important} /* Keep the environment visible: description remains in case panel. */
@media(max-width:760px){html[data-game='town'] .hotspot{width:44px!important;height:44px!important;min-width:44px!important;max-width:44px!important}html[data-game='town'] .viewportTop .titleCard{max-width:61%!important}html[data-game='town'] .sceneBottom>.titleCard{max-width:48%!important}html[data-game='town'] .ng-gloss{font-size:.73rem!important}}

/* Case-specific interactions replace four look-alike quiz forms. */
.v32-puzzle{border:1px solid #4c5954;border-radius:7px;padding:18px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#172b30,#0c1c23);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #9ba69b1d,0 8px 28px #0006}
.v32-casehead{padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #7b8d8655}.v32-casehead small,.v32-file-number{font:800 .67rem ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#b4d5c8}.v32-casehead h3{font:700 clamp(1.45rem,2.4vw,1.9rem) Georgia,serif;color:#f1e6cb;margin:5px 0 8px}.v32-casehead p{font:.92rem/1.5 Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;color:#d6e2db}.v32-puzzle-controls{margin-top:18px;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.v32-evidence-cue{border-left:3px solid #c6bb8a;padding:13px 15px;background:#21333a;color:#e4e8df;line-height:1.48;font-size:.86rem;margin-top:14px}
.v32-caseboard{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#1a272b,#0c1b20)}.v32-claimcard{background:#e6dcc3;color:#2b332f;padding:16px;margin:12px 0;border:1px solid #a6a18e;box-shadow:3px 5px 0 #06101694;border-radius:3px}.v32-claimcard .v32-file-number{color:#606c62;border-bottom:1px solid #b9b09b;padding-bottom:9px}.v32-claimcard p{font:700 1.1rem/1.42 Georgia,serif;margin:13px 0}.v32-trays{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.v32-file-option{border:1px solid #a3a995;border-radius:3px;background:#d1d3bf;padding:10px 12px;color:#25372c;font:700 .72rem/1.35 ui-monospace,monospace;flex:1;min-width:105px}.v32-file-option.selected{background:#36594e;color:#e5f4dc;border-color:#36594e;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #c2dca6}
.v32-captiondesk{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#22292a,#10191b)}.v32-recordscene{height:210px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #a49e86;box-shadow:0 8px 18px #0008}.v32-recordscene img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.v32-recordscene>div{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:#051016bc;color:#f5efdc;padding:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font:700 .67rem ui-monospace,monospace}.v32-caption-row{background:#e6ddca;color:#29302b;border-radius:2px;margin:14px 0;padding:16px;box-shadow:2px 5px 1px #0006}.v32-caption-row .v32-file-number{color:#576455;margin-bottom:10px}.v32-caption-options{display:grid;gap:7px}.v32-caption-option{border:1px solid #b1b2a4;background:#f4eee1;border-radius:3px;color:#333c34;text-align:left;padding:10px;display:flex;gap:11px;font:600 .84rem/1.4 Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif}.v32-caption-option span{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 26px;height:26px;background:#d4d8cd;color:#475b4e;font:800 .8rem ui-monospace,monospace}.v32-caption-option.selected{background:#355d4d;color:#f2f3e7;border-color:#739a86}.v32-caption-option.selected span{background:#a7c6a8;color:#234232}
.v32-workshopmanual{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#212e32,#101b20)}.v32-manualspread{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:13px}.v32-manualspread>div{padding:15px;background:#e9e1c9;color:#293930;border:1px solid #b4ac95;box-shadow:2px 4px #0007}.v32-manualspread h4{font:.76rem ui-monospace,monospace;color:#415448;border-bottom:1px solid #aab09b;padding-bottom:12px}.v32-step-placed{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px dashed #abac9b;padding:9px 0}.v32-step-placed b{font:.7rem ui-monospace,monospace;flex:0 0 48px}.v32-step-placed span{flex:1;font:.78rem/1.4 Georgia,serif}.v32-step-placed button{background:#b84d41;color:white;border:0;border-radius:2px}.v32-instruction-strip{display:block;width:100%;border:1px dashed #899885;background:#cdd1bc;border-radius:3px;padding:10px;text-align:left;color:#28382e;font:.79rem/1.35 Georgia,serif;margin-bottom:8px}
.v32-counciltable{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,#5f4436,#1a2628 75%)}.v32-fundslots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.v32-fundslots>div{border:2px dashed #b6a79296;border-radius:5px;min-height:85px;padding:13px;color:#c7cabb;font:800 .72rem ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.05em}.v32-fundslots>div.filled{background:#dcd5be;color:#314135;border-style:solid}.v32-fundslots strong{display:block;font:700 .8rem/1.36 Georgia,serif;margin-top:6px;letter-spacing:0}.v32-petitionlist{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:13px}.v32-petition{width:100%;border:1px solid #a89f87;background:#ebe1c8;color:#27362f;border-radius:3px;padding:13px 16px;text-align:left;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:4px 8px;box-shadow:1px 4px 0 #0006}.v32-petition small{grid-column:1/-1;font:700 .6rem ui-monospace,monospace}.v32-petition b{font:.92rem Georgia,serif}.v32-petition span{font:700 .65rem ui-monospace,monospace;align-self:center}.v32-petition.approved{background:#c1d6ba;border-color:#81ad94}
@media(max-width:640px){.v32-puzzle{padding:12px}.v32-manualspread{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v32-trays{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}.v32-file-option{min-width:0}.v32-recordscene{height:180px}.v32-caption-row{padding:12px}.v32-fundslots{gap:5px}.v32-fundslots>div{min-height:100px;padding:9px}.v32-petition{padding:11px}.v32-petition b{font-size:.8rem}}

/* Mobile is a first-class layout: no tall column of controls beside the title. */
@media(max-width:650px){
 header{position:relative!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:stretch!important;gap:9px!important;padding:10px 12px!important}
 header .brand h1{font-size:1.04rem!important;line-height:1.16!important;max-width:none!important}
 header .brand p{font-size:.71rem!important;margin-top:3px!important}
 header .brand .eyebrow{font-size:.6rem!important}
 header .toptools{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;width:100%!important;gap:6px!important}
 header .toptools>.btn{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;padding:7px 3px!important;font-size:.62rem!important;line-height:1.2!important;text-align:center!important;white-space:normal!important}
 .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:6px!important;padding:8px 12px!important}
 .stat{padding:8px!important}.stat label{font-size:.68rem!important}.main{padding:10px!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:10px!important}
}

/* FLAGSHIP BUILD ADDITIONS */
.headerFlag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(143,230,198,.12);border:1px solid rgba(143,230,198,.22);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#b9ffe8}
.sectionSeal{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#ddeef2;text-transform:uppercase}
.briefGrid,.dossierGrid,.decisionGrid,.puzzleGrid{display:grid;gap:12px}
.briefGrid{grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr}.dossierGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.decisionGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr))}.puzzleGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.dossierCard,.briefCard,.decisionCard,.criterionCard,.sortCard,.budgetCard,.witnessCard,.fieldCard,.writerPanel,.reportChecklist,.successPanel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,31,40,.96),rgba(10,18,24,.98));border:1px solid rgba(207,242,248,.14);border-radius:18px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.briefCard h4,.dossierCard h4,.decisionCard h4,.sortCard h4,.budgetCard h4,.witnessCard h4,.fieldCard h4,.writerPanel h4,.reportChecklist h4,.successPanel h4{margin:.2em 0 .4em 0}
.kv{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:.35rem 0 .6rem}.kv span,.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-size:.78rem;color:#dcedf2}
.docSheet{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8f1e6,#efe3cf 60%,#e7d8c0);border-radius:20px;padding:20px;color:#29353c;border:1px solid rgba(39,50,58,.12);box-shadow:0 25px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.25);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.docSheet:before{content:'';position:absolute;right:-28px;top:-28px;width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(39,50,58,.08),transparent 70%)}
.docSheet h3{font-size:1.35rem;margin:.2em 0 .3em}.docSheet ul{padding-left:1.2rem}.docSheet li{margin:.45rem 0;line-height:1.45}.docMeta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:.5rem 0 1rem}.docMeta span{font-size:.78rem;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(39,50,58,.08);border:1px solid rgba(39,50,58,.12)}
.docAside{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:14px}.sideNote{background:rgba(6,16,22,.92);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:18px;padding:14px;color:#e9f7fb}
.sideNote .soft{color:#bfd7df}
.clueFrame{position:relative;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(230,251,255,.16);min-height:300px;background:#0e1920}
.clueFrame .clipBg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;transform:scale(1.03)}
.focusBox{position:absolute;border:2px solid rgba(245,219,151,.92);box-shadow:0 0 0 200vmax rgba(0,0,0,.18),0 0 24px rgba(245,219,151,.4);border-radius:10px;backdrop-filter:blur(1px)}
.noteTape{position:absolute;left:18px;top:18px;padding:8px 12px;background:rgba(7,16,22,.82);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:12px;font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.12em}
.selectionBar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}.pickBtn{padding:9px 12px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:#edf9fb;font-weight:700}.pickBtn.active{background:rgba(143,230,198,.16);border-color:rgba(143,230,198,.45);color:#dffff3}
.sortCard p,.decisionCard p,.writerPanel p,.briefCard p,.fieldCard p,.dossierCard p{line-height:1.45}.evidenceRule{border-left:3px solid var(--accent);padding-left:10px;color:#dff5f7}
.timelineList,.criteriaList,.manualSlots{display:grid;gap:10px}
.manualSlots .picked{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:14px}
.stepPool{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
